protocol.selection: one global position; highest relative 24h return among qualifiers; lexical ties
protocol.execution: signal on completed hourly bar; trade at next hourly open with adverse slippage; close-based exit rules; no intrabar fill assumptions
protocol.primary: fixed rules; validation last 60 days; no parameter tuning
limitations: current watchlist survivorship and historical availability bias
historical spread/depth unavailable; slippage scenario only
no inference cost included; deterministic strategy test
maker case sensitivity only; no maker fill simulation
no tick-level stops; gap risk reflected in next open
not a forecast or proof of future profitability

evidence_threshold.note: screening threshold only; any passing candidate still needs untouched forward paper testing

rules.momentum: 24h return >2%, close>SMA72, 24h volume ratio>=1, BTC 24h return>0
rules.relative_strength: 24h return>0 and >BTC24h+2%, close>SMA72, volume ratio>=1, BTC24h>0
rules.breakout: close>previous24h high, current quote-volume>1.5x previous24h mean, BTC24h>0
rules.pullback: close>SMA168, SMA24>SMA72, 6h return<0, 1h return>0, 24h return>BTC24h, BTC24h>0
rules.exit: close loss>=5%, close gain>=10%, 72h maximum, or negative24h return after24h; next open execution
